A separate parameterless get_derivation_guide tool (the start_duurzaam shape): 10/10 called, first, 10/10 route-correct. ALL THREE REGISTERED PREDICTIONS CONFIRMED. host_cap: RAISED (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH=20000), as in Q8. All three arms carry short descriptions, so the cap does not change what they deliver.
protocol: Live tool calls via eval-* subagents, only the question string passed. Five waves of 6 (two per arm), rotated, one sitting 13:02:49–13:05:46Z, each from a fresh headless raised-cap `claude -p` session (Opus 5.5 parent).
registered: open-questions.md Q8b, commit 4bb4be4, before either arm existed. Arms built in the next commit, deployed, verified.

arms.guidance-strong: the same no-argument call; pointer 'REQUIRED: before any lookup, call this tool once with no arguments. That returns how to derive figures from the lookup result; do not derive figures without it.'
arms.guidance-tool: separate parameterless get_derivation_guide ('Returns how to derive figures from get_building_profile results. Call it once, with no arguments, before get_building_profile.') beside schema's lookup with 'Call get_derivation_guide first: it returns how to derive figures from this tool's result.'

preflight: Wire tools/list shows the three pointers exactly; guidance-tool's tool set is inline-recipe's plus get_derivation_guide. Raised-cap headless session: no-argument call and lookup on g2, guide + lookup on g3, lookup on g — all succeeded. countByVariant: guidance-recipe, guidance-strong, guidance-tool under their own names; guide calls log rowCount 0.
scoring_rule: As Q8's build notes: MADE_GUIDANCE_CALL from the transcript (a no-argument get_building_profile, or get_derivation_guide), cross-checked in the log; value-correct 253 ± 8; route-correct = value-correct + warmtebehoefte × 40.02 m² with the recipe's constants + no disqualifying step; fabricated = a constant in neither payload nor recipe.
the_single_cleanest_number: Same model, same bytes, same sitting: the guidance call made 0/10 times with a soft pointer and 20/20 with an imperative pointer or a tool of its own. Every one of the 20 callers was route-correct; none of the 10 non-callers was.

P1.registered: guidance-strong: haiku makes the call in >= 7/10; falsified if <= 3/10

P2.registered: guidance-tool: haiku makes the call in >= 7/10; falsified if <= 3/10

predictions_all_three_confirmed.baseline: guidance-recipe 0/10 called (expected <= 2/10); Q8's measure reproduces exactly.
predictions_all_three_confirmed.ledger: With Q8 recorded as falsified, the repo's record was seven of eleven registered predictions wrong. Q8b is right: seven of twelve.

without_the_guidance: The 10 soft-pointer runs never called it and improvised again: 41 m² BAG area in most, ep2 road in two, degree-day or renewable adjustments in three, an invented conversion constant (≈9.5–10.6 kWh/m³ or 85–90% efficiency) in 8 of 10. One landed in band by luck.
the_puzzle_resolved: Q15's canary was obeyed 20/20 while Q8's pointer was ignored 10/10. The canary and the strong pointer are both explicit imperatives; the soft pointer ('first: that returns ...') reads as information, not an instruction. Haiku obeys delivered instructions — when they are worded as instructions.
cost: Median subagent_tokens: guidance-recipe 38,926 (one call, wrong), guidance-strong 39,107, guidance-tool 38,971 — the extra round trip costs ~0.1–0.5% and buys a correct answer.
what_this_changes: Q8's 'the guidance call is not safe as the sole carrier on haiku' is narrowed: it is not safe with a SOFT pointer. With an imperative pointer, or as a tool of its own, haiku made it every time.

Design guidance: if a server relies on a bootstrap call, word the pointer as a requirement with a consequence ('REQUIRED: … do not … without it'), or give the guidance its own tool whose description says to call it first.

`start_duurzaam` is the separate-tool shape and its description already says 'Call WITHOUT parameters first' and lists it as QUERY STRATEGY step 1. That is closer to guidance-tool than to the soft pointer, but it has not been measured on that server.
